description_en: APARTMENT FOR SALE 1+1 apartment for sale in Kashar near Casa Italia with a construction area of ​​83.6m2 with regular documentation from the company, on the 6th floor of a new building with an elevator. The property has a very functional organization, 1 bedroom, kitchen + living room, corridor, distribution of all rooms, bathroom, balcony with exit from the room and the living room. Property specifications: The apartment will be given as investment by the company with: parquet, hood system, thermal insulation, incaso sanitary ware, plastic windows with triple glazing. The apartment is sold empty. Year of construction of the building: 2026
